data.headline: BOP to set up ‘Wholesale Banking Unit’ in Bahrain
data.summary: The Board of Directors of the BOP has approved the business plan to establish a Wholesale Banking Unit in the Kingdom of Bahrain and a representative office in the UAE.

data.headline: BoP partners with Google Cloud
data.summary: The BOP has joined forces with Google Cloud as a strategic partner for the Google Cloud Startup Competition Pakistan 2024, organised by Tech Valley and supported by Google Developers Group, a statement said.
